name: polyvinyl alcohol
uses: Uses for the temporary relief of burning, irritation and discomfort due to dryness of the eye or exposure to wind or sun may be used as a protectant against further irritation
otcwarn: Warnings Do not use if solution changes color or becomes cloudy When using this product Avoid contamination, do not touch tip of container to any surface. Replace cap after use Stop use and ask a doctor if you experience eye pain, changes in vision, continued redness or irritation of the eye the condition worsens or persists for more than 72 hours
